incident.observed: The frozen TG2R launcher exported TG2R_ARM and TG2R_TRAIN_SEED, while the inherited audit writer read TG2_ARM and TG2_TRAIN_SEED. The redundant arm field is therefore null in initialization and four-rank data-order sidecars.
unaffected_evidence: Training seed, rank, world size, microbatch count, sample count, and ordered-sample SHA-256 are present in every data-order record.
Initialization payload, parameter tree, trainable tree, optimizer tree, zero optimizer-state count, and route fields are present in every initialization record.
The frozen job identity, run directory, persisted full config, checkpoint, recipe, and route-specific environment remain unchanged.

amendment.scope: Recover only the redundant arm label in a temporary integrity overlay after independent route, seed, rank, count, and digest validation.
amendment.raw_preservation: Raw initialization and rank sidecars remain byte-identical and their SHA-256 values are recorded in every materialization and joint-integrity report.
amendment.normalization: A null arm is replaced by the prespecified run arm only in normalized copies. A non-null mismatched arm, route mismatch, seed mismatch, rank mismatch, count failure, or malformed digest is rejected.
